5. Md Lutfor Rahman, sub-Inspector police station Shyamnagar, District Satkhira as an information report lodged a First Information Report (FIR)'No. 25 dated 'I4-4-20 12 corresponding to GR No. 161 of 2012 at 18-30 hours with Shyamnagar. police station, Satkhira mentioning an occurrence dated 14-4-2012 at about 16-30 hours against 29 named accused persons along with 40/45 unknown persons excluding the petitioner under sections 143/120-B1124Ka/34 of the Penal Code. Thereafter the police investigation into the case and submitted charge sheet No. 400 dated 23-11-2014 against 34 accused persons including the petitioner under sections 143/120- B/12Ka of the Penal Code. But the said charge sheet has not yet been accepted. The petitioner was granted bail on 13-1-2013 in connection with the aforesaid case passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of Bangladesh, High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 748 of 2013 and he is now enjoying the privilege of bail. The next date of the case is fixed on 6-7-2015 for examination of charge-sheet. 

 6. Md Ekramul Haque Lawyer, son of Gazi Golam Mostafa of village Nakikpur, police station Shyamnagar, District Satkhira as an informant lodged a First Information Report (FIR) being No. 3 dated 1-10-2014 corresponding to GR No. 334 of 2014 at 22-45 hours with the Shyamnagar police station, Satkhira mentioning occurrence in between date3d 12-8-2014 at 10-00 hours in the morning and dated 15-8-2014 at 7-00 hours and 9.00 in the morning against 9 named accused persons including the petitioner along with unknown 5/7 persons under sections 120B/124A/34 of the Penal Code. Thereafter the police investigation into the case and submitted charge sheet No. 301 dated 11-10-2014 against 9 accused persons including the petitioner under section 143/3411 120B/124A/34 of the Penal Code. But the said charge sheet has not yet been accepted, the petitioner was granted bail by the Hon'ble High Court Division, Supreme Court of Bangladesh passed in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 17066 of 2015 in connection with the aforesaid case on 20-5- 2015 and he is now enjoying the privilege of bail. The next date of the case is fixed on 13-7-2015 for acceptance of original record.
